translations.web: Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his food is good.
translations.bsb: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.
translations.kjv: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
translations.asv: Therefore he sacrificeth unto his net, and burneth incense unto his drag; because by them his portion is fat, and his food plenteous.
